scenarios.name: a compilation published in one lane is restored in another with its paths rewritten
the lane that published also hits and a different key misses
a changed dependency misses in its lane only and the original content hits again
a missing dependency file is a miss
an observed environment variable decides the hit
an environment variable observed as unset must stay unset
an environment value that contains the lane is stored lane neutral
a removed object turns the entry into a miss and pruning drops the entry but not the other objects
only the newest eight variants of a key are kept and the newest matching one is used
a compilation without a dependency file or with a missing one is not published
two keys keep their own entries
pruning removes broken entries, empty entry directories and stale temporary files
objects are listed with size and use and removed by digest

runs.name: a build script run published in one lane is restored in another with its text rewritten and its binary untouched
a changed declared file or variable is a miss, a changed Rust source is not when inputs were declared and any changed package file is
without declared inputs every package file counts, Rust sources included
a declared directory is a tree fact
a run that cannot be replayed is not published
a binary output that does not contain the lane is kept as it is and a text output that does is a template

tree.name: files sorted by name inside each directory, depth first
an empty tree digests like no rows
ignored directories and extensions are skipped at any depth
exactly the maximum number of files is digested
one file beyond the maximum has no digest
ignored files do not count against the maximum
symbolic links are digested by their target text
unicode names sort by code unit
